info.title: Cadence API
info.description:
Drive Cadence from scripts, the CLI or your own tools: save check-ins, read and edit drafts, and read results.

**Limits:** 60 requests per minute per key (`RateLimit-*` headers on every response, `Retry-After` on 429), 20 check-ins a day, and model use capped by your plan.

**Scopes:** `read`, `write` (check-ins, edits, skips, setup) and `approve`, which you grant separately. There is no endpoint that publishes immediately; approved posts go out on your schedule.

**Disclaimer:** Cadence is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by LinkedIn. You are responsible for everything published from your account. Drafts are written by AI and can be wrong; approving a draft is your review of it. The API cannot comment, message, send connection requests or act on LinkedIn beyond publishing posts you approved, on your schedule. Approving drafts needs a key with the separate `approve` scope, which only you can grant, in Settings. Rate limits and endpoints may change with 30 days' notice in the changelog. Keys used abusively are revoked.
